To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of a change detection system can reduce the effort required to program a system; (2) the use of change detection can reduce the effort of testing a system; (3) the use of automatic change detection can reduce programmer errors; and (4) change detection can be used to improve the performance of a system.
we have developed a technique that automatically detects changes in object oriented systems with aliasing, and that this technique can be used to simplify object oriented design.

the automatic detection of changes in object oriented programs.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
automatic change detection can simplify the development of large object oriented systems, and so reduce the cost of development, and the likelihood of errors in the final system.
automatic change detection is a valuable and practical technique which can be used effectively in many object oriented systems.
automatic change detection can be used to simplify programming and design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an algorithm for automatic change detection in object oriented systems, which is based on the notion of a change graph.
we are able to automatically detect changes to an object, even when that object has been aliased or aggregated, and even if the object has been changed through a chain of method calls.
we have developed a program monitoring tool that automatically detects changes in objects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
aliasing and aggregation are key to change detection.
aliasing and aggregation are important issues to consider when implementing automatic change detection.
the use of aliasing and aggregation in a program is not necessarily a hindrance to change detection, and in some cases it can actually help.
